import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,"/app/tmp/work")
import genmaxp, check
import numpy as np
rng=random.Random(9)
req=genmaxp.gen_request(rng)
# make it infeasible: huge demands
for c in req["commodities"]: c["demand"]=1024
data=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
dt=time.time()-t0
print("max-size infeasible: %.2fs"%dt)
resp=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
d=check.build(req)
print("status",resp["status"],"errs",check.check(req,resp))
y=np.array(resp["certificate"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["certificate"]["equality"])
acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+d["A_eq"].T.dot(q)
val=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+float(d["b_eq"].dot(q))
print("viol=%.3g |y|max=%.4g norm=%.12g"%(float(acc.max()),np.abs(y).max(),val))
# and 64 copies for total time
data=("\n".join([json.dumps(req)]*64)+"\n").encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=900)
print("64 max-size infeasible lines: %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0))
PYEOF
